title: GeoReader: Learning Latent Geometry for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.18694v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with metric and multi-view relationships that remain implicit in RGB observations. Geometry foundation models recover this structure from RGB, but existing methods either fuse the estimated features with visual tokens and learn to use them from question answering alone, or align VLM latents with geometry features. Capturing geometry, however, does not ensure its use: zeroing the aligned latents of a released feature-alignment model leaves its accuracy unchanged. We introduce GeoReader, a framework that learns geometric representations for the VLM that reads them. First, we train lightweight Geometric Readers to produce continuous input tokens, supervising them with geometry descriptions decoded by a frozen VLM, so that the Readers express geometry in a form the target model can already read. translated_title: GeoReader：学习潜在几何表示以实现视觉-语言模型中的空间推理
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）在处理RGB观测中隐含的度量和多视角关系时表现不佳。几何基础模型能够从RGB中恢复这种结构，但现有方法要么将估计的特征与视觉token融合，并仅通过问答学习使用它们，要么将VLM的潜在表示与几何特征对齐。然而，捕获几何信息并不能确保其被使用：将一个已发布的特征对齐模型的对齐潜在表示置零后，其准确率没有任何变化。我们提出了GeoReader，一个为会读取这些表示的VLM学习几何表示的框架。首先，我们训练轻量级的几何读取器生成连续的输入token，并用冻结的VLM解码出的几何描述来监督它们，使读取器以目标模型已经能够读取的形式表达几何信息。然后，我们冻结这些读取器以保留该接口，同时在空间问答任务上对VLM进行微调，利用几何（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 提出GeoReader框架，通过训练轻量级几何读取器将几何信息编码为VLM可直接读取的连续token，并冻结读取器以保持接口不变，再对VLM在空间问答任务上微调，从而有效提升视觉-语言模型的空间推理能力。
en_tdlr: GeoReader trains lightweight Geometric Readers to encode geometry into continuous tokens that the target VLM can already read, then fine-tunes the VLM on spatial QA while freezing the Readers, enabling vision-language models to actually use latent geometric information for spatial reasoning.
